$comment: One entry per method: its body, or one body per request op (`selected_by`). `encoding` is the ResultPayload variant; a `Raw` body is a MessagePack `bin` holding the MessagePack encoding of `schema`, a `Json` body is that value as a JSON tree. A body with a `dynamic` reason is chosen by the caller and has the unconstrained schema `true`.

AdapterSpec.description: What the run trains. Adapter-only: full-weight mutation is not expressible.

ArrayEncoding.description: How the elements of a referenced array are encoded.

oneOf.description: Little-endian `u32` (token ids, sampler Top-K / auxiliary ids).

One byte per token, `1` = policy token (prompt, padding and tool
output tokens are `0` and masked from the loss).
Opaque bytes (logs, reports). Carries no element width.

CaptureEligibility.description: Whether a capture may be a training input, and if not, why.

CaptureTraceFidelity.description: How much of the trace the capture kept.

CompactNodesResult.description: Result of `Method::CompactNodesByType`: the ids of the nodes compaction removed.

ControlSetting.description: One of the three independent controls. Disabled unless a record says so.

scope.description:
The authorization scope allowed to request this control. An enabled
control must name one.

DecayStats.description:
Result of an Ebbinghaus forgetting-curve decay sweep (CONCEPT:EG-KG.compute.typed-graph-model).

`*_decayed` count items whose belief `confidence` was reduced this sweep;
`*_pruned` count items removed because their decayed confidence fell below
the sweep `floor`.

Digest256.description: 32 bytes of SHA-256 as lowercase hexadecimal

EvaluationMetrics.description:
Held-out measurements. Ratios are parts-per-million, never floats, so the
record digest is exact.

EvaluationVerdict.description: The evaluator's decision. Loss movement is diagnostic, never a verdict.

GraphDiff.description:
What another graph has relative to this one (`Method::DiffAgainst`): nodes and
`(source, target)` edge keys added or removed, and nodes whose property bytes differ.

GraphMetrics.description: Runtime metrics for monitoring and observability.

HeldBlobRef.description:
A Blob-CAS object this record depends on. The engine checks, at commit,
that the caller holds a blob with this digest and exact length.

KlEstimator.description:
The KL estimator a KLPO job uses. Chosen by measured cost; there is no
platform default.

LoadReport.description: Summary of an RDF triple load (`eg_rdf::mapping::load_triples`).

multivalue.description: Multi-valued literal extras encountered (second+ literal per `(s,p)`).

LogprobSupport.description:
What an endpoint's sampler reports about the tokens it chose.

Attested by the capability probe, never inferred from a provider or host
name. `top_k == 0` means no alternative-token records are available.

chosen_token.description: The log-probability of each sampled token. Capture fails closed without it.

ModelPolicyVersion.description:
`ModelPolicyVersion/v1`: an immutable artifact identity. Bytes stay in the
external artifact store; EG holds identity and lineage. The record id the
engine returns IS the version id every capture and route refers to.

artifact_destination_ref.description:
Where a trained artifact is written. Always a NEW artifact: the live
one is never overwritten.

probe_digest.description: Digest of the probe evidence that attested this record.

capability_id.description:
The attested capability the sampler ran under; its `capture` control
must be enabled.

log_q.description: Frozen chosen-token log-probabilities, one per policy token.

sampler_version_id.description: The exact behaviour-policy version that sampled every policy token.

trajectory_id.description: The durable `:Trajectory` in the request graph (`StartTrajectory`).

trajectory_steps.description:
The trajectory's step count at capture. Later appends never change
what this capture describes.

PolicyControls.description:
`capture`, `train` and `promote` are independent: enabling one never
implies another. All three default to off.

PolicyEvaluation.description: `PolicyEvaluation/v1`: an independent held-out evaluation of one version.

PolicyEvolutionRecord.description: One stored record, tagged by kind.

PolicyRecordKind.description: The five record kinds, and the record-id prefix each carries.

PolicyRecordReceipt.description: The receipt of every policy-evolution write.

eligibility.description: Set for a capture: whether it may be a training input.

PolicyRecordView.description: One record as read back, with the server-stamped writer and time.

PolicyWriteDisposition.description: Whether a write created the record or found it already committed.

PropertyBlob.description:
A node or edge property object exactly as stored -- MessagePack bytes, carried as a
MessagePack `bin` on the wire.

PruneStats.description: Result of a lifecycle-aware pruning operation.

ResourceObservation.description: Observed resource use of one run.

RewardEvidenceSource.description:
Where a reward's evidence came from. `self_reported` is the acting
agent's own claim: kept as evidence, never trained on.

RewardRecord.description:
The terminal reward and the verifier that produced it. Micros, never a
float, so the record digest is exact.

SafetyOutcome.description: Whether the safety policy passed on the frozen set.

ScenePose.description:
A scene object's composed world transform (`Method::WorldTransform`) -- the wire
projection of `eg_core::scene::Pose`, the same `{translation, rotation, scale}` object a
scene node stores under its `pose` property.

SceneQuat.description: A rotation quaternion `(x, y, z, w)` of a scene-graph pose on the wire.

SceneVec3.description: A 3-vector of a scene-graph pose on the wire.

SparqlUpdateReport.description:
What one SPARQL UPDATE changed, whichever path executed it.

`ApplyMutation` has two executors: the per-graph gateway (one graph, the update
runs against its staged image) and the coordinated SPARQL-HTTP saga (the
`sparql_http_update_v1` event, which may create and rewrite several graphs). Both
answer with this one body; a per-graph update reports `updated_graphs: 1` and
`created_graphs: 0`.

updated_graphs.description: Graphs whose committed image this update replaced.

SubgraphEdge.description: One edge of a `Method::GetSubgraph` result -- one entry per parallel edge.

properties.description: The edge's property object, or `null` when it does not decode.

SubgraphNode.description: One node of a `Method::GetSubgraph` result, with its decoded property object.

properties.description: The node's property object, or `null` when it does not decode.

SubgraphResult.description:
The induced subgraph over a node-id set (`Method::GetSubgraph`): the nodes that exist
and every edge among them.

TrainingMethod.description:
The external optimisation method. KLPO is one option beside the existing
GRPO/DPO/SFT choices.

TrainingOutput.description: The new artifact a succeeded run produced.

TrainingRun.description:
`TrainingRun/v1`: the receipt of one external training job. EG records it;
it never optimises weights.

work_item_id.description: The native WorkItem that owned the attempt.

TrainingRunStatus.description:
Terminal status. Only a succeeded run carries an output, so a failed or
cancelled run has nothing a version could name.

VersionOrigin.description: How a model-policy version came to exist.

oneOf.description: A served base checkpoint (optionally with an existing adapter).
The output of one succeeded training run.
